name: sistema-lealtad
description: Sistema de Lealtad y Premiacion para tiendas fisicas

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @lealtad/api && npm run build -w @lealtad/admin-web && npm run build -w @lealtad/client-pwa && npm run build -w @lealtad/driver-pwa
scripts.staging:up: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -p xre-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml up -d --build
scripts.staging:down: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -p xre-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml down
scripts.staging:status: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -p xre-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml ps
scripts.staging:logs: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -p xre-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml logs -f --tail=100
scripts.staging:backup:test: docker compose --env-file .env.staging -p xre-staging -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.staging.yml --profile tools run --rm restore-test
scripts.production:config: docker compose --env-file .env.production -p lealtad-production -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml config --quiet
scripts.production:up: docker compose --env-file .env.production -p lealtad-production -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml up -d --build
scripts.production:down: docker compose --env-file .env.production -p lealtad-production -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml down
scripts.production:status: docker compose --env-file .env.production -p lealtad-production -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml ps
scripts.production:backup:test: docker compose --env-file .env.production -p lealtad-production -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.production.yml --profile tools run --rm restore-test
